questions_and_answers.question_text: Die Herren Burger und Adams trafen sich an der Theaterkasse.

answers.answer_text: Messrs. Burger and Adams met each other at the box office.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dass wir uns ausgerechnet hier wiedersehen, hätte ich wissen sollen, sagte Adams.

answers.answer_text: I wish I had known that we were going to meet again here of all places, said Adams.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wenn Burger das geahnt hätte, hätte er Adams im Laufe des Tages angerufen.

answers.answer_text: If Burger had suspected that, he would have called Adams up in the course of the day.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er meinte, dann hätten sie Plätze nebeneinander bekommen können.

answers.answer_text: He was thinking then they could have gotten seats next to each other.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Burger hatte zwei Karten für den ersten Rang und hat eine an der Theaterkasse zurückgegeben.

answers.answer_text: Burger had two tickets for the dress circle and turned one in at the box office.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Die Plätze waren in der ersten Reihe.

answers.answer_text: The seats were in the first row.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Die Herren werden nun aber doch nebeneinander sitzen.

answers.answer_text: The gentlemen will be sitting next to each other after all now, however.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Adams hat nämlich an der Kasse die Karte bekommen, die von Burger zurückgegeben worden war.

answers.answer_text: Adams, you see, got the ticket at the box office that had been returned by Burger.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Als die Herren in das Foyer gingen, sahen sie einen grossen Andrang an der Garderobe.

answers.answer_text: When the gentlemen went into the lobby they saw a large crowd at the checkroom.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie müssten dort nicht anstehen, wären sie ohne Hut und Mantel gekommen.

answers.answer_text: They wouldn't have to wait in line there, had they come without their hats and coats.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Da sie noch ein paar Minuten Zeit haben, hätte sich Burger gern ein paar belegte Brötchen am Buffet geholt.

answers.answer_text: Since they have a few minutes (time) Burger would like to get himself a couple of sandwich rolls at the refreshment bar.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Adams möchte das auch tun, da sie an diesem Theaterbuffet immer ausgezeichnet sind.

answers.answer_text: Adams would like to do that too since they're always excellent at this refreshment bar.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Während Burger ihre Sachen an der Garderobe abgab, konnte Adams die Brötchen holen.

answers.answer_text: While Burger was checking their things at the cloakroom Adams was able to get the sandwich rolls.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Burger wollte eins mit Roastbeef und eins mit Kaviar.

answers.answer_text: Burger wanted one roast beef and one caviar.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Im Zuschauerraum hatten sie noch einige Minuten Zeit, bis die Ouvertüre anfing.

answers.answer_text: Inside the theater they had a few minutes time left until the overture began.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Adams fragte Burger nach seiner Geschäftsreise nach Bayreuth.

answers.answer_text: Adams asked Burger about his business trip to Bayreuth.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Burger wollte diese Reise eigentlich nicht machen.

answers.answer_text: Burger didn't actually want to take this trip.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er war dann aber doch ganz froh, dass er hatte fahren müssen.

answers.answer_text: But then he was very glad after all that he had had to go.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Als er in Bayreuth war, gab es dort nämlich eine neue Inszenierung von Wagners 'Tannhäuser'.

answers.answer_text: When he was in Bayreuth, you see, they were putting on a new staging of Wagner's Tannhäuser there.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Die hatte er sich nicht entgehen lassen wollen.

answers.answer_text: He had not wanted to miss that.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Richard Wagners beide Enkel gestalten in Bayreuth neue Inszenierungen der Werke des Meisters.

answers.answer_text: Richard Wagner's two grandsons are doing new stagings of the maestro's works in Bayreuth.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Richard Wagner selbst hätte sich das niemals vorstellen können.

answers.answer_text: Richard Wagner himself certainly wouldn't have allowed himself to dream of such a thing.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Burger hatte die Hüte und Mäntel abgegeben und die beiden Garderobenmarken eingesteckt, weil er dachte, sie könnten nach der Aufführung die Sachen zusammen abholen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Burger had checked the hats and coats and put the two cloakroom checks in his pocket because he thought they could pick up their things together after the performance.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Adams hatte zwei Programme geholt und gab eins davon Herrn Burger.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Adams had gone and gotten two programs and gave Mr. Burger one of them.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es war natürlich das Programm für die 'Tannhäuser'-Aufführung, die an dem Tag gegeben wurde.

answers.answer_text: It was, of course, the program for the performance of Tannhäuser which was being given that day.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Aber Burger wusste nicht, dass 'Tannhäuser' gegeben wurde.

answers.answer_text: But Burger didn't know that Tannhäuser was being given.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das war zu verstehen, weil er den Anschlag vor dem Theater nicht gesehen hatte.

answers.answer_text: That was understandable because he had not seen the poster in front of the theater.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Auf dem Anschlag stand: 'Statt Bizets 'Carmen', Wagners 'Tannhäuser'.'

answers.answer_text: It said on the poster: 'Instead of Bizet's Carmen Wagner's Tannhäuser.'

questions_and_answers.question_text: Der Spielplanwechsel fand wegen Erkrankung mehrerer Sänger statt.

answers.answer_text: The change of program was due to the illness of several singers.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Burger gab Adams seine Garderobenmarke und ging.

answers.answer_text: Burger gave Adams his cloakroom check and left.
